name: Are We There, Yeti?
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Now that I have what I need to cover the mechanical moving parts, I only need one other thing. Well, actually two. Two horns!

The ice thistle patriarchs and matriarchs have the largest horns, so of course, those are the ones I want. That type of yeti inhabits a cave to the southeast. There are plenty of them there; you shouldn't have any problem finding them.

Remember, I only want the best looking ones -- no beat up or broken horns, please!
narrative.objectives: Collect 2 Pristine Yeti Horns for Umi Rumplesnicker in Everlook.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I can't wait to show my friends! Now, just wait a moment while I attach these...

Perfect!
narrative.requestItemsText: I've just about finished attaching the fur, adventurer. Please, hurry back with those horns!
